import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras
from tensorflow.keras import layers
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
tf.random.set_seed(42)
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Features (exclude Id and target)
feature_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]


# Feature engineering: add derived features based on domain knowledge
def add_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Soil type count (sum of soil type columns)
    soil_cols = [c for c in df.columns if "Soil_Type" in c]
    df["Soil_Type_Count"] = df[soil_cols].sum(axis=1)

    # Horizontal distance combinations
    df["Hydro_Road_Diff"] = (
        df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"] - df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"]
    )
    df["Hydro_Fire_Diff"] = (
        df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"]
        - df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"]
    )
    df["Road_Fire_Diff"] = (
        df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] - df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"]
    )

    # Combined distances (manhattan)
    df["Hydro_Total"] = np.abs(df["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"]) + np.abs(
        df["Vertical_Distance_To_Hydrology"]
    )

    # Hillshade energy (sum of Hillshade columns)
    hill_cols = [c for c in df.columns if "Hillshade" in c]
    df["Hillshade_Total"] = df[hill_cols].sum(axis=1)

    return df


train = add_features(train)
test = add_features(test)
feature_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]

# Prepare data
X = train[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
y = train["Cover_Type"].values - 1  # Convert 1-indexed labels to 0-indexed
X_test = test[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

# Normalize features
mean = X.mean(axis=0)
std = X.std(axis=0)
X = (X - mean) / std
X_test = (X_test - mean) / std

# Split: 90% train, 10% val
X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y
)


# Build model
def create_model(input_dim, num_classes=7):
    model = keras.Sequential(
        [
            layers.Input(shape=(input_dim,)),
            layers.Dense(256, kernel_initializer="glorot_normal"),
            layers.BatchNormalization(),
            layers.Activation("relu"),
            layers.Dropout(0.3),
            layers.Dense(128, kernel_initializer="glorot_normal"),
            layers.BatchNormalization(),
            layers.Activation("relu"),
            layers.Dropout(0.3),
            layers.Dense(64, kernel_initializer="glorot_normal"),
            layers.BatchNormalization(),
            layers.Activation("relu"),
            layers.Dropout(0.2),
            layers.Dense(num_classes, activation="softmax"),
        ]
    )
    return model


# Create model
model = create_model(X_train_full.shape[1], num_classes=7)

# Compile with label smoothing and reduced learning rate
model.compile(
    optimizer=keras.optimizers.Adam(learning_rate=0.002),
    loss=keras.losses.SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(label_smoothing=0.05),
    metrics=["accuracy"],
)

# Callbacks
early_stopping = keras.callbacks.EarlyStopping(
    monitor="val_accuracy", patience=15, restore_best_weights=True, verbose=0
)

reduce_lr = keras.callbacks.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    monitor="val_accuracy", factor=0.5, patience=5, min_lr=1e-6, verbose=0
)

# Train model
history = model.fit(
    X_train_full,
    y_train_full,
    validation_data=(X_val, y_val),
    epochs=100,
    batch_size=1024,
    callbacks=[early_stopping, reduce_lr],
    verbose=0,
)

# Evaluate on validation set
val_probs = model.predict(X_val, verbose=0)
val_preds = np.argmax(val_probs, axis=1)
val_acc = accuracy_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_acc:.6f}")

# Make predictions on test set
test_probs = model.predict(X_test, verbose=0)
test_preds = np.argmax(test_probs, axis=1) + 1  # Convert back to 1-indexed

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": sample_sub["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_preds})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
